Waits for the display to finish showing a picture, which is used to keep a program at the speed of the display.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
Local t = MilliSecs()
VWait 30
Print "30 frames took " + (MilliSecs() - t) + " ms"
WaitKey
```
@param frames  How many frames to wait for. Defaults to 1.
@gap There is no vertical blank to wait for, so VWait waits 16 milliseconds for each frame (60 frames per second). Use `Flip` with `vwait` for the real display timing.
